claim: numerical checks for one explicitly assumed generic section; no Lightmatter device accuracy claim

assumptions.geometry: 16 um wide; 6 um silicon substrate, 2 um BOX; 0.5 x 0.22 um silicon core; 2 x 0.1 um heater in oxide at z=1 um
assumptions.power_convention: total heater watts over modeled_length_m; deposited load sums to 1
assumptions.boundary: finite bottom Robin thermal contact to ambient; top and both sides adiabatic; all boundary states retain consistent capacitance
assumptions.materials: constant illustrative bulk k/rhoCp: Si 130/1.63e6, SiO2 1.4/1.55e6, generic resistive heater 20/2.8e6 (SI units)
assumptions.ring_observation: uniform volume-average silicon-core temperature; no optical mode weighting

thermal_params.provenance: generic SOI scikit-fem congruence ROM; NOT calibrated to Lightmatter

coarse.transient_method: full sparse backward Euler, 8 subdivisions per log-spaced interval; ROM exact ZOH
